female.sp: Preserve the Tieren Taozi as one clearly adult woman with a fully human face, exactly two biological arms and two legs, and an upright humanoid body. Translate the canonical vivid pink armor, lavender chest and limb panels, dark charcoal joints and undersuit, and round amber-yellow hip and knee thruster caps faithfully. Keep both massive articulated curved shoulder shield-thruster pods present and symmetrical, with their outer pink shells and yellow vent fins. Mount one long 200 mm smoothbore cannon along the right forearm at believable scale; retain the compact chest machine-gun ports without duplicating the cannon. Keep the single tall cylindrical rear propellant tank centered behind the torso/waist and fully visible as mechanical backpack equipment. Translate the horizontal mono-eye head into a compact pink-lavender sensor circlet with one central golden sensor above the unobstructed human eyes; no robot head and no helmet covering the face. The open armor may reveal tasteful, secure, fully opaque areas at the upper torso, waist, hips and thighs while retaining both shoulder pods and all signature structures. Full-body vertical composition with all equipment and feet inside frame, subject at the largest practical scale and minimal empty margins. Simple soft dark-neutral background, no battlefield, no pilot resemblance, no text, logo or watermark.
